note: text = subtitles (same sentences as say); say = spelled for the voice. Every number is from flow3d/trace.json.

blocks.text: Monday morning, Manchester. Emma Clarke buys parts for Northbridge Cycles. She types one question: how many city e-bike battery packs do we have? Seconds later, she has her answer. So what happened in between?
blocks.say: Monday morning, Manchester. Emma Clarke buys parts for Northbridge Cycles. She types one question: how many city e-bike battery packs do we have? Seconds later, she has her answer. So what happened in between?

blocks.text: Her words don't go to the model first. They go to the harness, the code around the model. Think of an assembly bench. Our rules. Her message. A description of every tool, all fifteen. Stacked together: one request, 2,139 tokens.
blocks.say: Her words don't go to the model first. They go to the harness, the code around the model. Think of an assembly bench. Our rules. Her message. A description of every tool, all fifteen. Stacked together: one request, two thousand, one hundred and thirty-nine tokens.

blocks.text: The model reads every one of those tokens. And here's the twist: it doesn't answer. It can't see the stock. So it picks one tool of fifteen, find_item, and writes its arguments as JSON.
blocks.say: The model reads every one of those tokens. And here's the twist: it doesn't answer. It can't see the stock. So it picks one tool of fifteen, find item, and writes its arguments as JSON.

blocks.text: Can we trust what it wrote? Not yet. The guard checks it against the tool's schema: the right fields, the right types. Then MCP, the standard plug, carries it to the toolbox.
blocks.say: Can we trust what it wrote? Not yet. The guard checks it against the tool's schema: the right fields, the right types. Then M C P, the standard plug, carries it to the toolbox.

blocks.text: Behind the toolbox sits Ledgerline ERP 7.2, a system from 1998. The tool calls it with Emma's own permissions. We never open this cabinet: data in, data out.
blocks.say: Behind the toolbox sits Ledgerline E R P seven point two, a system from nineteen ninety-eight. The tool calls it with Emma's own permissions. We never open this cabinet: data in, data out.

blocks.text: The result goes back into the context, and the loop goes round again. Search the manuals. Check the stock. Each lap, the request grows. Five model calls later: 6,600 packs, eleven days of cover.
blocks.say: The result goes back into the context, and the loop goes round again. Search the manuals. Check the stock. Each lap, the request grows. Five model calls later: six thousand six hundred packs, eleven days of cover.

blocks.text: Then Emma asks for more: order 2,000 battery packs from Voltway Cells. The model tries a direct order, and the tool says no. Direct orders stop at £50,000. This one is £285,600. Raise a purchase request first.
blocks.say: Then Emma asks for more: order two thousand battery packs from Voltway Cells. The model tries a direct order, and the tool says no. Direct orders stop at fifty thousand pounds. This one is two hundred and eighty-five thousand, six hundred. Raise a purchase request first.

blocks.text: So the model builds the request, as a preview. Nothing is saved. £273,600: above Emma's limit, so Daniel Okafor must approve. Shall I go ahead? Emma says yes.
blocks.say: So the model builds the request, as a preview. Nothing is saved. Two hundred and seventy-three thousand, six hundred pounds: above Emma's limit, so Daniel Okafor must approve. Shall I go ahead? Emma says yes.

blocks.text: Only now is anything written. Ledgerline saves the request, and PR/2026/04417 lands in Daniel's approval inbox.
blocks.say: Only now is anything written. Ledgerline saves the request, and request zero four four one seven lands in Daniel's approval inbox.

blocks.text: One last step: the tool reads the record back. Waiting for approval. What Emma sees is what the ERP really holds.
blocks.say: One last step: the tool reads the record back. Waiting for approval. What Emma sees is what the E R P really holds.

blocks.text: One sentence in. A receipt out. The harness builds the context. The model picks a tool. The guard checks it. MCP carries it. And Ledgerline does the work.
blocks.say: One sentence in. A receipt out. The harness builds the context. The model picks a tool. The guard checks it. M C P carries it. And Ledgerline does the work.
